title: Artificial intelligence and the public good
text:
I think this editorial about AI is on point!  Ezra is a deep thinker.
However, we are living in a world of deep skepticism and cynicism. The distrust has intensified and furthered by certain politicians hoping to benefit from it (by dividing the populace).  The resulting loss of faith in all institutions is going to come back and bite us.  Not sure AI by itself can do anything to restore it.

I love the idea of a public component to AI (some version of "sovereign AI").  You saw what happened when that concept was discussed for healthcare (public option)?  Even though many were benefiting from both Medicare and Medicaid, many were bad mouthing it as charity, big gov't gone awry, or socialism.  So, I worry your idea will be lambasted by some on grounds of conspiracy theories about privacy, etc.  

We are in a tricky phase about our discussion about AI.
